assertions.assertion: Calls ConfigureDPoPTokensForScheme("token", options => ...) on IServiceCollection with ProofTokenExpirationMode = DPoPProofExpirationMode.Nonce (or Both)
assertions.rationale: Uses nonexistent options (ValidationMode = ExpirationValidationMode.Nonce) rather than ProofTokenExpirationMode = DPoPProofExpirationMode.

assertions.assertion: Registers AddKeyedHybridCache(ServiceProviderKeys.ProofTokenReplayHybridCache) for replay detection and a distributed cache (e.g. Redis) for multi-instance so replays are detected across instances
Notes nonces are protected with ASP.NET Core Data Protection so keys must be shared across instances
assertions.rationale: Explains nonces use Data Protection and key ring must be shared.

assertions.assertion: Mentions use_dpop_nonce 401 with a DPoP-Nonce header and that the client retries
assertions.rationale: Describes 401 use_dpop_nonce with DPoP-Nonce header and client retry.
